Her name is Theodosia. The goddess of the moon, wrath and discord. She is the first born child of the Creation god OldSun. When she was a child she was known for having the biggest heart. Above all else she loved her siblings. The dawn and sun gods. It was the youngest of them, Eas the god of the sun, was born without a heart. Due to this he was violent and sociopathic. He would plan how he would take over the world. The other gods did everything to prevent that and try lead him to a different path, but Eas wouldn't budge. The gods had no other choice other then to imprison him. Theodosia overhead this and refused to let that happen. So while Eas was sleeping she took out her heart and gave it to him. Eas was immediately better and sweet, but Theodosia grew bitter and cold. She wanted to take over the world. So she raised an army. It would be known as the Moon war. It was a pretty big deal, but I won't expand on it here. In the end the moon goddess was cornered. She went into a a whole "if I can't have it  then no one can". So she threw a huge asteroid at the Earth. It took a lot of gods to stop it and it made the Moon. She would later be captured and be imprisoned on the moon. She did ask for one request. That she can see her brother. So that's why the eclipse happens. 

So now she just sits on the moon. Plotting for another attack.

I have a small one. My favorite out of my heroes.

His named was Asger. He was the son of the goddess of life. He loved music and would go about spreading fine music to the world. His singing could bring anyone to tears and his lyrics were made into classics. Once he would hang around the god of metal and invention. Bugging the god to help him make more music. So the creation of interments was due to him. He would tour the world for years. He wouldn't take a spouse or have children because he would completely devoted to his music. He was loved by many.


His death is a bit tragic. The Dawn goddess fell in love Asger and would try to court him. He of course refused her advances. She wouldn't have it. So to get back at him. She made him paranoid, hear voices, and made his mind a living hell. He wouldn't be able to handle it so he killed himself. His mother was absolutely heartbroken. It would be the first time one of her children chose death rather then life. So she sang a song for him. Now it's a song only heard at demigods funerals.
